title: The Loch Ness monster
text: Loch Ness is a big lake in Scotland. The water is very deep and very dark. Many people say that a monster lives in the lake. Its name is Nessie.
What does Nessie look like? People say it has a long neck, a small head and a big body. It looks like a dinosaur that swims.

Where does the story come from? In 1933 a couple saw a strange animal in the water. In 1934 a famous photo showed a long neck in the lake. Many years later, people discovered that the photo was a trick: it was a toy!
Do scientists believe in Nessie? Not really. They looked for the monster with special machines, but they did not find it. Maybe people see big fish, boats or waves.
Who visits the lake? Every year, thousands of tourists come to Loch Ness. They take photos, they ride boats and they buy Nessie toys. Is Nessie real? What do you think?
q: What is the name of the monster?
What do tourists do at Loch Ness?
They take photos and ride boats
